Details of the Onboarding Process

This document describes the standard onboarding process (so called Future Onboarding Process - FOP).

Note: In the embedded image the following relabels apply:

  • DCCG -> TNG

  • CSCA -> SCA

  • DCC -> VDHC (Verifiable Digital Health Certificate)

  • NB -> TNP

It is highly recommended:

  • To use certificates issued from a public CA which follows the CAB Forum Rules

  • Not to reuse any certificates across the different staging environments

In the following description the required steps are divided into three sections:

[1] - [29] - Application and Verification
[30] - [59] Setup
[60] - [End] Participant Onboarding

head.prose:
####  Details of the Onboarding Process

This page describes the standard onboarding process (the so called Future Onboarding Process, FOP) of the GDHCN. It has two parts. The first part is an overview of the business processes, drawn in BPMN 2.0. The second part, [the step-by-step description](#step-by-step-description), is the original text of this page with its numbered steps **[n]** and the original drawing.

Where a drawing and a text differ, the text is authority: the GDHCN Administrative and Operational Framework first, then the step text on this page. The drawings only refer to the documentation; requirements such as key sizes are stated in the documentation they name, for example [the requirements on GPG keys](concepts_certificate_governance.html#gpg-keys).

head.prose:
#### Overview of the onboarding processes

Onboarding runs in three phases. In **phase 1** the Participant applies and has its Letter of Application verified (steps [1]-[29]). In **phase 2** the gateway operator registers the Participant's keys, once for each environment (steps [30]-[59]). In **phase 3** the Participant connects to the gateway and passes the tests, first in UAT and then in PROD (steps [60]-[80]). After onboarding, a Participant may join a further Trust Domain, change its keys or its representatives, or end its participation, and an Eligible GDHCN Participant may propose a new Trust Domain.

Each drawing has one pool for each party (the GDHCN Participant, the GDHCN Secretariat at WHO, and the gateway operator) and one lane for each actor. A task with a **+** marker calls another process: select it in a drawing to go to that process. The environment (UAT, PROD, and DEV if used) is an input of the processes that run once for each environment.

Actors

Each lane is one actor, defined as an ActorDefinition of this guide.

Actor Role in onboarding
Business Owner Representative Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX).
Legal Representative May meet WHO in person to convey the Letter (Framework IX); receives notice of amendments (XI.2).
Official Delegate Delegate at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting (Framework IX).
Key Master Representative Manages the Participant's Public Key Infrastructure and holds the GPG key named in the Letter (Framework IX).
Technical Representative Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX).
GDHCN Secretariat Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI).
WHO Country Representative Meets the representative in country and sends the Letter by diplomatic pouch (Framework IX).
Trust Network Anchor WHO as trust anchor for the Public Key Infrastructure (Framework VI.6).
Operations Team The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]).
Onboarding Team The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]).
GitHub Bot The gateway's GitHub bot user for the environment (steps [11]-[13], [34]-[38]).
Trust Network Gateway The Trust Network Gateway (Framework V.1).

    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A.P.Invited" name="Invited?" default="A.F.inv">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [7].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>A.F.inv</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="A.P.Modify" name="Modify the data">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [6]: modify the data and re-apply.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="A.P.Keys" name="Prepare keys and repository" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="A.P.End" name="Letter verified">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="A.S.Letter" targetRef="A.S.End" />

<pre><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Apply to join and have the Letter of Application verified. Phase 1, steps [1]-[29]; Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="A.M.Interest" name="Statement of Interest" sourceRef="A.P.Interest" targetRef="A.S.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="A.M.Reject" name="Rejection" sourceRef="A.S.Reject" targetRef="A.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="A.M.Invite" name="Invitation and technical information" sourceRef="A.S.Invite" targetRef="A.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="A.M.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="A.P.Letter" targetRef="A.S.Letter" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant" name="Apply and be verified" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [1]-[14] and [20].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant.Lane.KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" partitionElementRef="KeyMasterRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Manages the Participant's Public Key Infrastructure and holds the GPG key named in the Letter (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/KeyMasterRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Interest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Invited</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Modify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.Letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>A.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="A.P.Start" name="Decided to apply">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VII.1.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="A.P.Interest" name="Send the Statement of Interest">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [1].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="A.P.Result" name="Receive the result of the check">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [5] and [8].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="A.P.Invited" name="Invited?" default="A.F.inv">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [7].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>A.F.inv</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="A.P.Modify" name="Modify the data">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [6]: modify the data and re-apply.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="A.P.Keys" name="Prepare keys and repository" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13], once for each environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>A.F.inv</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="A.P.Letter" name="Convey the Letter of Application" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [14]-[20]: one Letter for each Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="A.P.End" name="Letter verified">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for set-up, step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="A.P.Start" targetRef="A.P.Interest" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="A.P.Interest" targetRef="A.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="A.P.Result" targetRef="A.P.Invited" />

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="A.S.Rejected" name="Application rejected">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="A.S.Start" targetRef="A.S.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="A.S.Check" targetRef="A.S.Ok" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" name="no" sourceRef="A.S.Ok" targetRef="A.S.Reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="A.S.Reject" targetRef="A.S.Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="A.S.Invite" targetRef="A.S.Letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="A.S.Letter" targetRef="A.S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Change the keys or the representatives after onboarding. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="CK.M.Keys" name="Technical change" sourceRef="CK.P.Send" targetRef="CK.S.Keys" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="CK.M.Reps" name="New representatives" sourceRef="CK.P.Reps" targetRef="CK.S.RStart" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="CK.M.Hand" name="New keys" sourceRef="CK.S.Hand" targetRef="CK.O.Start" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant" name="Report a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.Lane.KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" partitionElementRef="KeyMasterRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Manages the Participant's Public Key Infrastructure and holds the GPG key named in the Letter (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/KeyMasterRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.KStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.RStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.Reps</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.REnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.Send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.KEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.P.RStart" name="Representatives change">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX, last paragraph.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_122</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CK.P.Reps" name="Notify the new representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: notify the Secretariat in a timely manner.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_122</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_123</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.P.REnd" name="Change notified">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_123</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.P.KStart" name="Keys change">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: changes to the technical information.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_124</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.P.Keys" name="Prepare the new key material" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>As steps [9]-[13].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_124</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_125</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.P.Send" name="Convey the change by secure channel" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: changes to the technical information go through the same secure channels.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_125</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_126</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.P.KEnd" name="Change conveyed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_126</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_122" sourceRef="CK.P.RStart" targetRef="CK.P.Reps" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_123" sourceRef="CK.P.Reps" targetRef="CK.P.REnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_124" sourceRef="CK.P.KStart" targetRef="CK.P.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_125" sourceRef="CK.P.Keys" targetRef="CK.P.Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_126" sourceRef="CK.P.Send" targetRef="CK.P.KEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat" name="Verify a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.RStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.Reps</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.REnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.KStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.Hand</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.KEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.S.RStart" name="New representatives received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_127</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CK.S.RStart.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CK.S.Reps" name="Record the new representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_127</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_128</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.S.REnd" name="Representatives recorded">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_128</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.S.KStart" name="Change expected">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_129</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.S.Keys" name="Verify the change" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>As steps [15]-[23].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_129</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_130</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CK.S.Hand" name="Send the new keys to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_130</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_131</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.S.KEnd" name="Change verified">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_131</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_127" sourceRef="CK.S.RStart" targetRef="CK.S.Reps" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_128" sourceRef="CK.S.Reps" targetRef="CK.S.REnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_129" sourceRef="CK.S.KStart" targetRef="CK.S.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_130" sourceRef="CK.S.Keys" targetRef="CK.S.Hand" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_131" sourceRef="CK.S.Hand" targetRef="CK.S.KEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator" name="Register changed keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>As phase 2 of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.O.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.O.Start" name="New keys received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_132</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CK.O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.O.Keys" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As phase 2, for each changed environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_132</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_133</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.O.End" name="New keys live">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_133</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_132" sourceRef="CK.O.Start" targetRef="CK.O.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_133" sourceRef="CK.O.Keys" targetRef="CK.O.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

<pre><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Change the keys or the representatives after onboarding. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="CK.M.Keys" name="Technical change" sourceRef="CK.P.Send" targetRef="CK.S.Keys" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="CK.M.Reps" name="New representatives" sourceRef="CK.P.Reps" targetRef="CK.S.RStart" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="CK.M.Hand" name="New keys" sourceRef="CK.S.Hand" targetRef="CK.O.Start" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant" name="Report a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.Lane.KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" partitionElementRef="KeyMasterRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Manages the Participant's Public Key Infrastructure and holds the GPG key named in the Letter (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/KeyMasterRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.KStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.RStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.Reps</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.REnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.Send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.P.KEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.P.RStart" name="Representatives change">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX, last paragraph.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_122</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CK.P.Reps" name="Notify the new representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: notify the Secretariat in a timely manner.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_122</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_123</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.P.REnd" name="Change notified">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_123</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.P.KStart" name="Keys change">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: changes to the technical information.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_124</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.P.Keys" name="Prepare the new key material" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>As steps [9]-[13].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_124</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_125</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.P.Send" name="Convey the change by secure channel" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: changes to the technical information go through the same secure channels.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_125</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_126</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.P.KEnd" name="Change conveyed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_126</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_122" sourceRef="CK.P.RStart" targetRef="CK.P.Reps" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_123" sourceRef="CK.P.Reps" targetRef="CK.P.REnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_124" sourceRef="CK.P.KStart" targetRef="CK.P.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_125" sourceRef="CK.P.Keys" targetRef="CK.P.Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_126" sourceRef="CK.P.Send" targetRef="CK.P.KEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat" name="Verify a change" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.RStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.Reps</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.REnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.KStart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.Hand</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.S.KEnd</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.S.RStart" name="New representatives received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_127</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CK.S.RStart.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="CK.S.Reps" name="Record the new representatives">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_127</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_128</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.S.REnd" name="Representatives recorded">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_128</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.S.KStart" name="Change expected">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_129</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="CK.S.Keys" name="Verify the change" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>As steps [15]-[23].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_129</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_130</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="CK.S.Hand" name="Send the new keys to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_130</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_131</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CK.S.KEnd" name="Change verified">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_131</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_127" sourceRef="CK.S.RStart" targetRef="CK.S.Reps" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_128" sourceRef="CK.S.Reps" targetRef="CK.S.REnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_129" sourceRef="CK.S.KStart" targetRef="CK.S.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_130" sourceRef="CK.S.Keys" targetRef="CK.S.Hand" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_131" sourceRef="CK.S.Hand" targetRef="CK.S.KEnd" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator" name="Register changed keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>As phase 2 of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ChangeKeys.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OperationsTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.O.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CK.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="CK.O.Start" name="New keys received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_132</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="CK.O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="TrustNetworkGateway" name="Trust Network Gateway" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Connect to the gateway and pass the test, for one environment. Steps [43]-[46], [60]-[66] (UAT) and [67]-[76] (PROD).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Info" name="Connection information" sourceRef="X.O.Inform" targetRef="X.P.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Res" name="Test results" sourceRef="X.P.Send" targetRef="X.O.Recv" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Fix" name="Corrective actions" sourceRef="X.O.Fix" targetRef="X.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Pass" name="Test passed" sourceRef="X.O.End" targetRef="X.P.Result" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant" name="Connect and test" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [60]-[63] and [70]-[73].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" partitionElementRef="TechnicalRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TechnicalRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Connect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Conn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Fix</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="X.P.Start" name="Connection information received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [46] and [69].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_89</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="X.P.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.P.Connect" name="Connect to the gateway">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [60] and [70].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_89</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_92</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_90</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="X.P.Conn" name="Connected?" default="X.F.conn">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [61] and [71].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_90</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>X.F.conn</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_91</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.P.Fix" name="Correct the connection with the operations team">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [61] and [71].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_91</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_92</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.P.Test" name="Run the test">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [62]: the UAT dry run. Step [72]: the PROD readiness test.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>X.F.conn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_96</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_93</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="X.P.Send" name="Send the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [63] and [73].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_93</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_94</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="X.P.Result" name="Receive the check result">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [65] and [75].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_94</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_95</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="X.P.Ok" name="Passed?" default="X.F.pok">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_95</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>X.F.pok</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_96</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="X.P.End" name="Test passed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>X.F.pok</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_89" sourceRef="X.P.Start" targetRef="X.P.Connect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_90" sourceRef="X.P.Connect" targetRef="X.P.Conn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="X.F.conn" name="yes" sourceRef="X.P.Conn" targetRef="X.P.Test" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_91" name="no" sourceRef="X.P.Conn" targetRef="X.P.Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_92" sourceRef="X.P.Fix" targetRef="X.P.Connect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_93" sourceRef="X.P.Test" targetRef="X.P.Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_94" sourceRef="X.P.Send" targetRef="X.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_95" sourceRef="X.P.Result" targetRef="X.P.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="X.F.pok" name="yes" sourceRef="X.P.Ok" targetRef="X.P.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_96" name="no, after correction" sourceRef="X.P.Ok" targetRef="X.P.Test" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator" name="Whitelist and check the test" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43]-[46], [64]-[69] and [74]-[76].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" partitionElementRef="OnboardingTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OnboardingTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Inform</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Recv</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Fix</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.Lane.TrustNetworkGateway" name="Trust Network Gateway" partitionElementRef="TrustNetworkGateway">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Trust Network Gateway (Framework V.1). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TrustNetworkGateway.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.White</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="X.O.Start" name="Keys registered">
      <bpmn:documentation>Input: the environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_97</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="X.O.White" name="Whitelist the certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43] (UAT) and [67] (PROD, after the dry run passed).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_97</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_98</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="X.O.Inform" name="Send the connection information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [44]-[45] and [68].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_98</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_99</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="X.O.Recv" name="Receive the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [64] and [74].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_99</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_103</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.O.Check" name="Check the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [65] and [75].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_101</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="X.O.Ok" name="Passed?" default="X.F.ook">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_101</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>X.F.ook</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_102</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="X.O.Fix" name="Agree corrective actions">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [66] and [76].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_102</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_103</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="X.O.End" name="Test passed">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Participant is told the test passed.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>X.F.ook</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="X.O.End.Def" />
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_97" sourceRef="X.O.Start" targetRef="X.O.White" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_98" sourceRef="X.O.White" targetRef="X.O.Inform" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_99" sourceRef="X.O.Inform" targetRef="X.O.Recv" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_100" sourceRef="X.O.Recv" targetRef="X.O.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_101" sourceRef="X.O.Check" targetRef="X.O.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="X.F.ook" name="yes" sourceRef="X.O.Ok" targetRef="X.O.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_102" name="no" sourceRef="X.O.Ok" targetRef="X.O.Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_103" sourceRef="X.O.Fix" targetRef="X.O.Recv" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Diagram">

<pre><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="TrustNetworkGateway" name="Trust Network Gateway" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Connect to the gateway and pass the test, for one environment. Steps [43]-[46], [60]-[66] (UAT) and [67]-[76] (PROD).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Info" name="Connection information" sourceRef="X.O.Inform" targetRef="X.P.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Res" name="Test results" sourceRef="X.P.Send" targetRef="X.O.Recv" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Fix" name="Corrective actions" sourceRef="X.O.Fix" targetRef="X.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="X.M.Pass" name="Test passed" sourceRef="X.O.End" targetRef="X.P.Result" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant" name="Connect and test" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [60]-[63] and [70]-[73].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" partitionElementRef="TechnicalRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TechnicalRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Connect</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Conn</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Fix</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Test</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Result</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="X.P.Start" name="Connection information received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [46] and [69].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_89</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="X.P.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.P.Connect" name="Connect to the gateway">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [60] and [70].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_89</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_92</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_90</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="X.P.Conn" name="Connected?" default="X.F.conn">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [61] and [71].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_90</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>X.F.conn</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_91</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.P.Fix" name="Correct the connection with the operations team">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [61] and [71].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_91</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_92</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.P.Test" name="Run the test">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [62]: the UAT dry run. Step [72]: the PROD readiness test.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>X.F.conn</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_96</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_93</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="X.P.Send" name="Send the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [63] and [73].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_93</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_94</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="X.P.Result" name="Receive the check result">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [65] and [75].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_94</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_95</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="X.P.Ok" name="Passed?" default="X.F.pok">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_95</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>X.F.pok</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_96</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="X.P.End" name="Test passed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>X.F.pok</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_89" sourceRef="X.P.Start" targetRef="X.P.Connect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_90" sourceRef="X.P.Connect" targetRef="X.P.Conn" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="X.F.conn" name="yes" sourceRef="X.P.Conn" targetRef="X.P.Test" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_91" name="no" sourceRef="X.P.Conn" targetRef="X.P.Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_92" sourceRef="X.P.Fix" targetRef="X.P.Connect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_93" sourceRef="X.P.Test" targetRef="X.P.Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_94" sourceRef="X.P.Send" targetRef="X.P.Result" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_95" sourceRef="X.P.Result" targetRef="X.P.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="X.F.pok" name="yes" sourceRef="X.P.Ok" targetRef="X.P.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_96" name="no, after correction" sourceRef="X.P.Ok" targetRef="X.P.Test" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator" name="Whitelist and check the test" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43]-[46], [64]-[69] and [74]-[76].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" partitionElementRef="OnboardingTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OnboardingTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Inform</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Recv</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Fix</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Operator.Lane.TrustNetworkGateway" name="Trust Network Gateway" partitionElementRef="TrustNetworkGateway">
        <bpmn:documentation>The Trust Network Gateway (Framework V.1). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TrustNetworkGateway.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>X.O.White</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="X.O.Start" name="Keys registered">
      <bpmn:documentation>Input: the environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_97</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="X.O.White" name="Whitelist the certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [43] (UAT) and [67] (PROD, after the dry run passed).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_97</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_98</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="X.O.Inform" name="Send the connection information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [44]-[45] and [68].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_98</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_99</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="X.O.Recv" name="Receive the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [64] and [74].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_99</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_103</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="X.O.Check" name="Check the test results">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [65] and [75].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_101</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="X.O.Ok" name="Passed?" default="X.F.ook">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_101</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>X.F.ook</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_102</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="X.O.Fix" name="Agree corrective actions">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [66] and [76].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_102</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_103</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="X.O.End" name="Test passed">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Participant is told the test passed.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>X.F.ook</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="X.O.End.Def" />
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_97" sourceRef="X.O.Start" targetRef="X.O.White" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_98" sourceRef="X.O.White" targetRef="X.O.Inform" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_99" sourceRef="X.O.Inform" targetRef="X.O.Recv" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_100" sourceRef="X.O.Recv" targetRef="X.O.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_101" sourceRef="X.O.Check" targetRef="X.O.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="X.F.ook" name="yes" sourceRef="X.O.Ok" targetRef="X.O.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_102" name="no" sourceRef="X.O.Ok" targetRef="X.O.Fix" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_103" sourceRef="X.O.Fix" targetRef="X.O.Recv" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Plane" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConnectTest.Collaboration">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OfficialDelegate" name="Official Delegate" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:resource id="WHOCountryRepresentative" name="WHO Country Representative" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Convey a Letter of Application through a secure channel. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="C.M.Country" name="Letter and passport" sourceRef="C.P.Country" targetRef="C.S.Meet" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="C.M.Assembly" name="Letter and passport" sourceRef="C.P.Assembly" targetRef="C.S.Assembly" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant" name="Convey the Letter" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: the Letter goes through a secure channel.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Channel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Country</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant.Lane.OfficialDelegate" name="Official Delegate" partitionElementRef="OfficialDelegate">
        <bpmn:documentation>Delegate at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OfficialDelegate.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Assembly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C.P.Start" name="Letter signed">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: officially signed, one for each Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_39</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.P.Channel" name="Which secure channel?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX names two.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_39</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_40</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_41</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.P.Country" name="Meet WHO in country with passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: with the WHO Country Representative or authorized Secretariat staff. The Legal Representative may meet instead.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_40</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_42</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.P.Assembly" name="Meet WHO at a governing body with passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_41</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_43</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.P.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_42</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_43</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_44</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C.P.End" name="Letter conveyed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_44</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="C.P.Start" targetRef="C.P.Channel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" name="in country" sourceRef="C.P.Channel" targetRef="C.P.Country" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" name="governing body" sourceRef="C.P.Channel" targetRef="C.P.Assembly" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" sourceRef="C.P.Country" targetRef="C.P.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" sourceRef="C.P.Assembly" targetRef="C.P.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" sourceRef="C.P.Merge" targetRef="C.P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat" name="Receive the Letter" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: the Letter reaches WHO Headquarters through a secure channel.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Channel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Assembly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat.Lane.WHOCountryRepresentative" name="WHO Country Representative" partitionElementRef="WHOCountryRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Meets the representative in country and sends the Letter by diplomatic pouch (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/WHOCountryRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Meet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Pouch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C.S.Start" name="Letter expected">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_45</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.S.Channel" name="Which secure channel?">
      <bpmn:documentation>As the Participant conveys it.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_45</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_46</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_47</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.S.Meet" name="Meet the representative and check passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_46</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_48</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C.S.Pouch" name="Send the Letter by diplomatic pouch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: from the WHO Country Office, or the Permanent Mission in Geneva, to WHO Headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_48</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_49</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.S.Assembly" name="Meet the delegate and check passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_47</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_50</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.S.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_49</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_50</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_51</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C.S.End" name="Letter at WHO Headquarters">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_51</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_45" sourceRef="C.S.Start" targetRef="C.S.Channel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_46" name="in country" sourceRef="C.S.Channel" targetRef="C.S.Meet" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_47" name="governing body" sourceRef="C.S.Channel" targetRef="C.S.Assembly" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_48" sourceRef="C.S.Meet" targetRef="C.S.Pouch" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_49" sourceRef="C.S.Pouch" targetRef="C.S.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_50" sourceRef="C.S.Assembly" targetRef="C.S.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_51" sourceRef="C.S.Merge" targetRef="C.S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Pool.Secretariat_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Pool.Secretariat" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="430" width="970" height="320" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OfficialDelegate" name="Official Delegate" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:resource id="WHOCountryRepresentative" name="WHO Country Representative" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Convey a Letter of Application through a secure channel. Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="C.M.Country" name="Letter and passport" sourceRef="C.P.Country" targetRef="C.S.Meet" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="C.M.Assembly" name="Letter and passport" sourceRef="C.P.Assembly" targetRef="C.S.Assembly" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant" name="Convey the Letter" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: the Letter goes through a secure channel.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Channel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Country</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Participant.Lane.OfficialDelegate" name="Official Delegate" partitionElementRef="OfficialDelegate">
        <bpmn:documentation>Delegate at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OfficialDelegate.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.P.Assembly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C.P.Start" name="Letter signed">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: officially signed, one for each Trust Domain.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_39</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.P.Channel" name="Which secure channel?">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX names two.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_39</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_40</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_41</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.P.Country" name="Meet WHO in country with passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: with the WHO Country Representative or authorized Secretariat staff. The Legal Representative may meet instead.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_40</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_42</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.P.Assembly" name="Meet WHO at a governing body with passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: at the World Health Assembly or another WHO governing body meeting.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_41</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_43</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.P.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_42</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_43</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_44</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C.P.End" name="Letter conveyed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_44</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_39" sourceRef="C.P.Start" targetRef="C.P.Channel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_40" name="in country" sourceRef="C.P.Channel" targetRef="C.P.Country" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_41" name="governing body" sourceRef="C.P.Channel" targetRef="C.P.Assembly" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_42" sourceRef="C.P.Country" targetRef="C.P.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_43" sourceRef="C.P.Assembly" targetRef="C.P.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_44" sourceRef="C.P.Merge" targetRef="C.P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat" name="Receive the Letter" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: the Letter reaches WHO Headquarters through a secure channel.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Channel</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Assembly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat.Lane.WHOCountryRepresentative" name="WHO Country Representative" partitionElementRef="WHOCountryRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Meets the representative in country and sends the Letter by diplomatic pouch (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/WHOCountryRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Meet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>C.S.Pouch</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="C.S.Start" name="Letter expected">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_45</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.S.Channel" name="Which secure channel?">
      <bpmn:documentation>As the Participant conveys it.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_45</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_46</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_47</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.S.Meet" name="Meet the representative and check passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_46</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_48</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="C.S.Pouch" name="Send the Letter by diplomatic pouch">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: from the WHO Country Office, or the Permanent Mission in Geneva, to WHO Headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_48</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_49</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="C.S.Assembly" name="Meet the delegate and check passport">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_47</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_50</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="C.S.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_49</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_50</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_51</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="C.S.End" name="Letter at WHO Headquarters">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_51</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_45" sourceRef="C.S.Start" targetRef="C.S.Channel" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_46" name="in country" sourceRef="C.S.Channel" targetRef="C.S.Meet" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_47" name="governing body" sourceRef="C.S.Channel" targetRef="C.S.Assembly" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_48" sourceRef="C.S.Meet" targetRef="C.S.Pouch" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_49" sourceRef="C.S.Pouch" targetRef="C.S.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_50" sourceRef="C.S.Assembly" targetRef="C.S.Merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_51" sourceRef="C.S.Merge" targetRef="C.S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the keys and the repository for one environment. Steps [9]-[13]; Framework V.4.c, VII.4-5 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="K.M.Invite" name="Repository invitation" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="KB.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="K.M.Accept" name="Invitation accepted" sourceRef="KB.Accept" targetRef="K.Accept" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant" name="Prepare keys and repository" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13], for one environment.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant.Lane.KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" partitionElementRef="KeyMasterRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Manages the Participant's Public Key Infrastructure and holds the GPG key named in the Letter (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/KeyMasterRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Certs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Gpg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Repo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Publish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Invite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Expired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="K.Start" name="Invitation to onboard received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [8]. Input: the environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Split" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[11] run in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Certs" name="Create the TLS, upload and SCA certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [9], as concepts_CertificatePreperation describes.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Gpg" name="Create a GPG key for each authorized person">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [10], as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes; the requirements are in concepts_certificate_governance.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Repo" name="Create the private GitHub repository">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [11].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Join" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Publish" name="Commit the public keys and sign a tag">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9] and [11], as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_33</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="K.Invite" name="Invite the GitHub bot">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [11]-[12].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_33</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_36</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_34</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="K.Accept" name="Receive the acceptance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [13].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_34</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_35</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="K.Expired" name="Invitation expired" attachedToRef="K.Accept" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [12]: the invitation loses validity after the period the page gives.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_36</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="K.Expired.Def"><bpmn:timeDuration>P7D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="K.End" name="Keys and repository ready">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for the Letter of Application, step [14].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_35</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="K.Start" targetRef="K.Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Certs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Gpg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Repo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="K.Certs" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="K.Gpg" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="K.Repo" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="K.Join" targetRef="K.Publish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="K.Publish" targetRef="K.Invite" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="K.Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="K.Accept" targetRef="K.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="K.Expired" targetRef="K.Invite" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator" name="Accept the repository invitation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Step [13].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator.Lane.GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" partitionElementRef="GitHubBot">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway's GitHub bot user for the environment (steps [11]-[13], [34]-[38]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GitHubBot.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>KB.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>KB.Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>KB.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="KB.Start" name="Invitation received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [12].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_37</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="KB.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="KB.Accept" name="Accept the invitation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [13]: WHO accepts through the bot user.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_37</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_38</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="KB.End" name="Repository readable">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_38</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="KB.Start" targetRef="KB.Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="KB.Accept" targetRef="KB.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
