<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Prepare the keys and the repository for one environment. Steps [9]-[13]; Framework V.4.c, VII.4-5 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="K.M.Invite" name="Repository invitation" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="KB.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="K.M.Accept" name="Invitation accepted" sourceRef="KB.Accept" targetRef="K.Accept" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant" name="Prepare keys and repository" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[13], for one environment.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Participant.Lane.KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" partitionElementRef="KeyMasterRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Manages the Participant's Public Key Infrastructure and holds the GPG key named in the Letter (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/KeyMasterRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Certs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Gpg</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Repo</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Publish</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Invite</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.Expired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>K.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="K.Start" name="Invitation to onboard received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [8]. Input: the environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Split" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9]-[11] run in parallel.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Certs" name="Create the TLS, upload and SCA certificates">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [9], as concepts_CertificatePreperation describes.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Gpg" name="Create a GPG key for each authorized person">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [10], as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes; the requirements are in concepts_certificate_governance.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Repo" name="Create the private GitHub repository">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [11].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="K.Join" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="K.Publish" name="Commit the public keys and sign a tag">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [9] and [11], as concepts_onboarding_checklist describes.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_33</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="K.Invite" name="Invite the GitHub bot">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [11]-[12].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_33</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_36</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_34</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="K.Accept" name="Receive the acceptance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [13].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_34</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_35</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="K.Expired" name="Invitation expired" attachedToRef="K.Accept" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [12]: the invitation loses validity after the period the page gives.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_36</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="K.Expired.Def"><bpmn:timeDuration>P7D</bpmn:timeDuration></bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="K.End" name="Keys and repository ready">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for the Letter of Application, step [14].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_35</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="K.Start" targetRef="K.Split" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Certs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Gpg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="K.Split" targetRef="K.Repo" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="K.Certs" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="K.Gpg" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="K.Repo" targetRef="K.Join" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="K.Join" targetRef="K.Publish" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_33" sourceRef="K.Publish" targetRef="K.Invite" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_34" sourceRef="K.Invite" targetRef="K.Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_35" sourceRef="K.Accept" targetRef="K.End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_36" sourceRef="K.Expired" targetRef="K.Invite" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator" name="Accept the repository invitation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Step [13].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.PrepareKeys.Operator.Lane.GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" partitionElementRef="GitHubBot">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway's GitHub bot user for the environment (steps [11]-[13], [34]-[38]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GitHubBot.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>KB.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>KB.Accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>KB.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="KB.Start" name="Invitation received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [12].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_37</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="KB.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="KB.Accept" name="Accept the invitation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [13]: WHO accepts through the bot user.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_37</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_38</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="KB.End" name="Repository readable">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_38</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_37" sourceRef="KB.Start" targetRef="KB.Accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_38" sourceRef="KB.Accept" targetRef="KB.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="TrustNetworkAnchor" name="Trust Network Anchor" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" />
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Register a Participant's keys for one environment. Phase 2, steps [31]-[50].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="R.M.Sig" name="Signed keys" sourceRef="R.T.Sign" targetRef="R.O.Sig" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="R.M.Fail" name="Verification failed" sourceRef="R.O.Fail" targetRef="R.P.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="R.M.Fix" name="Correction" sourceRef="R.P.Fix" targetRef="R.B.Again" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat" name="Verify and sign PROD keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [36]-[37] and [47]; Framework VI.6.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat.Lane.TrustNetworkAnchor" name="Trust Network Anchor" partitionElementRef="TrustNetworkAnchor">
        <bpmn:documentation>WHO as trust anchor for the Public Key Infrastructure (Framework VI.6). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TrustNetworkAnchor.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.T.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.T.Sign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.T.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="R.T.Start" name="PROD pull request open">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [36]: for PROD, the pull request is verified by WHO.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_65</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="R.T.Sign" name="Verify the PR and sign air-gapped">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [36]-[37].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_65</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_66</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="R.T.End" name="PROD keys signed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_66</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_65" sourceRef="R.T.Start" targetRef="R.T.Sign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_66" sourceRef="R.T.Sign" targetRef="R.T.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator" name="Register the keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [31]-[50], for one environment.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OperationsTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Config</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Sig</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Verify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Failed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.Lane.GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" partitionElementRef="GitHubBot">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Again</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Pr</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Env</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Auto</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="R.O.Start" name="Onboarding information received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30]. Input: the environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_67</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="R.O.Config" name="Add the data to the configuration files">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [31]-[33].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_67</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_68</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="R.O.Sig" name="Receive the signed keys">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_72</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_73</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="R.O.Merge" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_73</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_74</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_75</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="R.O.Verify" name="Verify the pull request">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [39] (UAT) and [47] (PROD).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_75</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_76</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="R.O.Ok" name="Passed?" default="R.F.ok">

      <bpmn:outgoing>R.F.ok</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_77</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>R.F.ok</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_68</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_69</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_70</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_71</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_74</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_67" sourceRef="R.O.Start" targetRef="R.O.Config" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_68" sourceRef="R.O.Config" targetRef="R.B.Pr" />

<pre><?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="TrustNetworkAnchor" name="Trust Network Anchor" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" />
  <bpmn:resource id="KeyMasterRepresentative" name="Key Master Representative" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Register a Participant's keys for one environment. Phase 2, steps [31]-[50].</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="R.M.Sig" name="Signed keys" sourceRef="R.T.Sign" targetRef="R.O.Sig" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="R.M.Fail" name="Verification failed" sourceRef="R.O.Fail" targetRef="R.P.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="R.M.Fix" name="Correction" sourceRef="R.P.Fix" targetRef="R.B.Again" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat" name="Verify and sign PROD keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [36]-[37] and [47]; Framework VI.6.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Secretariat.Lane.TrustNetworkAnchor" name="Trust Network Anchor" partitionElementRef="TrustNetworkAnchor">
        <bpmn:documentation>WHO as trust anchor for the Public Key Infrastructure (Framework VI.6). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TrustNetworkAnchor.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.T.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.T.Sign</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.T.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="R.T.Start" name="PROD pull request open">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [36]: for PROD, the pull request is verified by WHO.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_65</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="R.T.Sign" name="Verify the PR and sign air-gapped">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [36]-[37].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_65</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_66</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="R.T.End" name="PROD keys signed">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_66</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_65" sourceRef="R.T.Start" targetRef="R.T.Sign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_66" sourceRef="R.T.Sign" targetRef="R.T.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator" name="Register the keys" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Steps [31]-[50], for one environment.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Config</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Sig</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Verify</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Ok</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Fail</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.O.Failed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator.Lane.GitHubBot" name="GitHub Bot" partitionElementRef="GitHubBot">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway's GitHub bot user for the environment (steps [11]-[13], [34]-[38]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GitHubBot.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Again</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Pr</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Env</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>R.B.Auto</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30]. Input: the environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_67</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_68</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_73</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_73</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_74</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_75</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [39] (UAT) and [47] (PROD).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_75</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_76</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

      <bpmn:outgoing>R.F.ok</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_78</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_78</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_68</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_69</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_70</bpmn:outgoing>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>End participation in one or more Trust Domains. Framework XV.1-3; XV.4 (the Secretariat ceases the GDHCN) is out of scope.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="E.M" name="Notice of termination" sourceRef="E.P.Notice" targetRef="E.S.Start" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Participant" name="Leave the GDHCN" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework XV.1.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Terminate.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>E.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>E.P.Notice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>E.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="E.P.Start" name="Decided to leave">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework XV.1: for one or more Trust Domains.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_134</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="E.P.Notice" name="Send written notice by diplomatic channel">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework XV.1: at least 30 days ahead.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_134</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_135</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="E.P.End" name="Notice given">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_135</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_134" sourceRef="E.P.Start" targetRef="E.P.Notice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_135" sourceRef="E.P.Notice" targetRef="E.P.End" />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.P.Again</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.P.Convey</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>V.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="V.S.Start" name="Letter expected">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [15].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_57</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.S.Again" name="">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_57</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_62</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_58</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="V.S.Receive" name="Receive the Letter" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.ConveyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [15], through a secure channel (Framework IX).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_58</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_59</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.S.Check" name="Verify accuracy, eligibility and rules">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [18]; Framework V.4.a and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_59</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_60</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="V.S.Ok" name="Compliant?" default="V.F.ok">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [19].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_60</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>V.F.ok</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_61</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="V.S.Fail" name="Inform the Participant of the failure">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [19], by email.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_61</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_62</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.S.Gpg" name="Check each GPG key">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [21]-[22]: the key holds the email given in the Letter and meets the GPG key requirements in concepts_certificate_governance.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>V.F.ok</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_63</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="V.S.Collect" name="Collect the information for the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [23], as listed there.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_63</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_64</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="V.S.End" name="Letter verified">
      <bpmn:documentation>Ready for hand-over, step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_64</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_57" sourceRef="V.S.Start" targetRef="V.S.Again" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_58" sourceRef="V.S.Again" targetRef="V.S.Receive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_59" sourceRef="V.S.Receive" targetRef="V.S.Check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_60" sourceRef="V.S.Check" targetRef="V.S.Ok" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="V.F.ok" name="yes" sourceRef="V.S.Ok" targetRef="V.S.Gpg" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_61" name="no" sourceRef="V.S.Ok" targetRef="V.S.Fail" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_62" sourceRef="V.S.Fail" targetRef="V.S.Again" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_63" sourceRef="V.S.Gpg" targetRef="V.S.Collect" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_64" sourceRef="V.S.Collect" targetRef="V.S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

head.prose:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Onboard a GDHCN Participant to a Trust Domain, in three phases: apply and verify (steps [1]-[29]), set up (steps [30]-[59]) and go live (steps [60]-[80]). Framework V.4, VI.5 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Apply" name="Statement of Interest and Letter of Application" sourceRef="T.P.Apply" targetRef="T.S.Apply" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Hand" name="Onboarding information" sourceRef="T.S.Handover" targetRef="T.O.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Live" name="Connection information and test results" sourceRef="T.O.Live" targetRef="T.P.Live" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Ready" name="Production Readiness confirmed" sourceRef="T.O.Live" targetRef="T.S.Ready" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant" name="Join the GDHCN" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Participant side of onboarding, phase by phase.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.Apply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" partitionElementRef="TechnicalRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TechnicalRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="T.P.Start" name="Decided to join the GDHCN">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Participant determines which Trust Domains it intends to participate in (Framework VII.1).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.P.Apply" name="Apply and be verified" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 1, steps [1]-[29].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.P.Live" name="Connect and test" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 3, steps [60]-[78], for UAT and then PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="T.P.End" name="Onboarded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [78]: the Participant may use the gateway in PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="T.P.Start" targetRef="T.P.Apply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="T.P.Apply" targetRef="T.P.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="T.P.Live" targetRef="T.P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator" name="Set up the gateway" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The gateway operator side of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OperationsTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.Setup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" partitionElementRef="OnboardingTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OnboardingTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="T.O.Start" name="Onboarding information received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="T.O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.O.Setup" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 2, steps [31]-[50], once for each environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.O.Live" name="Whitelist and check the tests" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 3, steps [43]-[46] and [64]-[77], for UAT and then PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="T.O.End" name="Participant live in PROD">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [78].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="T.O.Start" targetRef="T.O.Setup" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="T.O.Setup" targetRef="T.O.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="T.O.Live" targetRef="T.O.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat" name="Oversee onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Secretariat side of onboarding (Framework VI.5).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Apply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Ready</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="T.S.Start" name="Ready to receive applications">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.S.Apply" name="Check the application and the Letter" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 1, steps [1]-[29].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="T.S.Handover" name="Send onboarding information to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30]: the information collected in step [23].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="T.S.Ready" name="Receive the readiness confirmation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [77].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T.S.Record" name="Record the Participant as onboarded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [79]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="T.S.End" name="Onboarding overseen">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="T.S.Start" targetRef="T.S.Apply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="T.S.Apply" targetRef="T.S.Handover" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="T.S.Handover" targetRef="T.S.Ready" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="T.S.Ready" targetRef="T.S.Record" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="T.S.Record" targetRef="T.S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.ONB.Diagram">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.ONB.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.ONB.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Onboard a GDHCN Participant to a Trust Domain, in three phases: apply and verify (steps [1]-[29]), set up (steps [30]-[59]) and go live (steps [60]-[80]). Framework V.4, VI.5 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Apply" name="Statement of Interest and Letter of Application" sourceRef="T.P.Apply" targetRef="T.S.Apply" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Hand" name="Onboarding information" sourceRef="T.S.Handover" targetRef="T.O.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Live" name="Connection information and test results" sourceRef="T.O.Live" targetRef="T.P.Live" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="T.M.Ready" name="Production Readiness confirmed" sourceRef="T.O.Live" targetRef="T.S.Ready" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant" name="Join the GDHCN" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Participant side of onboarding, phase by phase.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.Apply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" partitionElementRef="TechnicalRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TechnicalRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="T.P.Start" name="Decided to join the GDHCN">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Participant determines which Trust Domains it intends to participate in (Framework VII.1).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.P.Apply" name="Apply and be verified" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 1, steps [1]-[29].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.P.Live" name="Connect and test" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 3, steps [60]-[78], for UAT and then PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="T.P.End" name="Onboarded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [78]: the Participant may use the gateway in PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="T.P.Start" targetRef="T.P.Apply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="T.P.Apply" targetRef="T.P.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="T.P.Live" targetRef="T.P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator" name="Set up the gateway" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The gateway operator side of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OperationsTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.Setup</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" partitionElementRef="OnboardingTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OnboardingTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="T.O.Start" name="Onboarding information received">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="T.O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.O.Setup" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 2, steps [31]-[50], once for each environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.O.Live" name="Whitelist and check the tests" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 3, steps [43]-[46] and [64]-[77], for UAT and then PROD.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="T.O.End" name="Participant live in PROD">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [78].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="T.O.Start" targetRef="T.O.Setup" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="T.O.Setup" targetRef="T.O.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="T.O.Live" targetRef="T.O.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat" name="Oversee onboarding" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>The Secretariat side of onboarding (Framework VI.5).</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Apply</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Handover</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Ready</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.Record</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>T.S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="T.S.Start" name="Ready to receive applications">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="T.S.Apply" name="Check the application and the Letter" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.Apply.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Phase 1, steps [1]-[29].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="T.S.Handover" name="Send onboarding information to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [30]: the information collected in step [23].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="T.S.Ready" name="Receive the readiness confirmation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Step [77].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="T.S.Record" name="Record the Participant as onboarded">
      <bpmn:documentation>Steps [79]-[80].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="T.S.End" name="Onboarding overseen">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VI.5.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="T.S.Start" targetRef="T.S.Apply" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="T.S.Apply" targetRef="T.S.Handover" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="T.S.Handover" targetRef="T.S.Ready" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="T.S.Ready" targetRef="T.S.Record" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="T.S.Record" targetRef="T.S.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="GDHCN.ONB.Diagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="GDHCN.ONB.Plane" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Collaboration">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Participant_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Participant" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="60" width="1110" height="320" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="60" width="1080" height="160" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="220" width="1080" height="160" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Operator_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Operator" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="430" width="1110" height="320" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="430" width="1080" height="160" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="590" width="1080" height="160" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Secretariat_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Pool.Secretariat" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="120" y="800" width="1110" height="160" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat_di" bpmnElement="GDHCN.ONB.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" isHorizontal="true"><dc:Bounds x="150" y="800" width="1080" height="160" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="T.P.Start_di" bpmnElement="T.P.Start"><dc:Bounds x="232" y="122" width="36" height="36" /><bpmndi:BPMNLabel><dc:Bounds x="195" y="162" width="110" height="28" /></bpmndi:BPMNLabel></bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="T.P.Apply_di" bpmnElement="T.P.Apply" isExpanded="false"><dc:Bounds x="330" y="80" width="120" height="120" /></bpmndi:BPMNShape>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Join a further Trust Domain once onboarded. Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="J.M.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="J.P.Letter" targetRef="J.S.Letter" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="J.M.Hand" name="Onboarding information" sourceRef="J.S.Hand" targetRef="J.O.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="J.M.Live" name="Connection information and test results" sourceRef="J.O.Live" targetRef="J.P.Live" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant" name="Join a further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.Letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" partitionElementRef="TechnicalRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TechnicalRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.P.Start" name="Decided to join a further Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VII.1 and V.4.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_113</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.P.Letter" name="Convey the Letter for it" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: one Letter for each Trust Domain, on that Trust Domain's Annex form.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_113</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_114</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.P.Live" name="Connect and test" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4.b-c and IX (user acceptance testing).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_114</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_115</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.P.End" name="Joined">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_115</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_113" sourceRef="J.P.Start" targetRef="J.P.Letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_114" sourceRef="J.P.Letter" targetRef="J.P.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_115" sourceRef="J.P.Live" targetRef="J.P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator" name="Set up the further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>As phases 2 and 3 of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OperationsTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" partitionElementRef="OnboardingTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OnboardingTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.O.Start" name="Onboarding information received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_119</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="J.O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.O.Keys" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As phase 2, for each environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_119</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_120</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.O.Live" name="Whitelist and check the tests" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As phase 3.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_120</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_121</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.O.End" name="Further Trust Domain live">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_121</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_119" sourceRef="J.O.Start" targetRef="J.O.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_120" sourceRef="J.O.Keys" targetRef="J.O.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_121" sourceRef="J.O.Live" targetRef="J.O.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat" name="Admit to a further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.Letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.Hand</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.S.Start" name="Ready to receive the Letter">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_116</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.S.Letter" name="Verify the Letter" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4.a-b and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_116</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_117</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="J.S.Hand" name="Send onboarding information to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_117</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_118</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.S.End" name="Handed over">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_118</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_116" sourceRef="J.S.Start" targetRef="J.S.Letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_117" sourceRef="J.S.Letter" targetRef="J.S.Hand" />

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Join a further Trust Domain once onboarded. Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Pool.Operator" name="Gateway operator" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>The service provider that operates the Trust Network Gateway (steps [30]-[80]).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="J.M.Letter" name="Letter of Application" sourceRef="J.P.Letter" targetRef="J.S.Letter" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="J.M.Hand" name="Onboarding information" sourceRef="J.S.Hand" targetRef="J.O.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="J.M.Live" name="Connection information and test results" sourceRef="J.O.Live" targetRef="J.P.Live" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant" name="Join a further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.Letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Participant.Lane.TechnicalRepresentative" name="Technical Representative" partitionElementRef="TechnicalRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Connects the Participant's systems to the Trust Network Gateway and runs the tests (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/TechnicalRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.P.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.P.Start" name="Decided to join a further Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework VII.1 and V.4.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_113</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.P.Letter" name="Convey the Letter for it" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework IX: one Letter for each Trust Domain, on that Trust Domain's Annex form.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_113</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_114</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.P.Live" name="Connect and test" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4.b-c and IX (user acceptance testing).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_114</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_115</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.P.End" name="Joined">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_115</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_113" sourceRef="J.P.Start" targetRef="J.P.Letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_114" sourceRef="J.P.Letter" targetRef="J.P.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_115" sourceRef="J.P.Live" targetRef="J.P.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator" name="Set up the further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>As phases 2 and 3 of onboarding.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator.Lane.OperationsTeam" name="Operations Team" partitionElementRef="OperationsTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's operations team (steps [30]-[50]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OperationsTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.Keys</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Operator.Lane.OnboardingTeam" name="Onboarding Team" partitionElementRef="OnboardingTeam">
        <bpmn:documentation>The gateway service provider's onboarding team (steps [64]-[77]). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/OnboardingTeam.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.Live</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.O.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.O.Start" name="Onboarding information received">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_119</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="J.O.Start.Def" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.O.Keys" name="Register the keys" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.RegisterKeys.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As phase 2, for each environment.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_119</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_120</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics />
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.O.Live" name="Whitelist and check the tests" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.GoLive.Operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As phase 3.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_120</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_121</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.O.End" name="Further Trust Domain live">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_121</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_119" sourceRef="J.O.Start" targetRef="J.O.Keys" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_120" sourceRef="J.O.Keys" targetRef="J.O.Live" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_121" sourceRef="J.O.Live" targetRef="J.O.End" />
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat" name="Admit to a further Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4 and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Join.Secretariat.Lane.GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" partitionElementRef="GDHCNSecretariat">
        <bpmn:documentation>Authorized WHO staff of the GDHCN Secretariat (Framework V, VI). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/GDHCNSecretariat.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.Letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.Hand</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>J.S.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="J.S.Start" name="Ready to receive the Letter">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_116</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:callActivity id="J.S.Letter" name="Verify the Letter" calledElement="GDHCN.ONB.VerifyLetter.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.4.a-b and IX.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_116</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_117</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:callActivity>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="J.S.Hand" name="Send onboarding information to the operator">
      <bpmn:documentation>As step [30].</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_117</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_118</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="J.S.End" name="Handed over">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_118</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_116" sourceRef="J.S.Start" targetRef="J.S.Letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_117" sourceRef="J.S.Letter" targetRef="J.S.Hand" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_118" sourceRef="J.S.Hand" targetRef="J.S.End" />

head.prose:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Definitions" targetNamespace="http://smart.who.int/trust/bpmn">
  <bpmn:resource id="BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" />
  <bpmn:resource id="GDHCNSecretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat" />
  <bpmn:collaboration id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Collaboration">
    <bpmn:documentation>Propose a new Trust Domain and have it approved. Framework V.3, VI.2-3 and XI.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Pool.Participant" name="GDHCN Participant" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant">
      <bpmn:documentation>The Eligible GDHCN Participant (Framework VII).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:participant id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Pool.Secretariat" name="GDHCN Secretariat (WHO)" processRef="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>The GDHCN Secretariat at WHO (Framework V, VI).</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:participant>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="TP.M" name="Trust Domain proposal" sourceRef="TP.Send" targetRef="TS.Start" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="TP.M2" name="Annex published" sourceRef="TS.Publish" targetRef="TP.Recv" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant" name="Propose a Trust Domain" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:laneSet id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant.LaneSet">
      <bpmn:lane id="GDHCN.TrustDomain.Propose.Participant.Lane.BusinessOwnerRepresentative" name="Business Owner Representative" partitionElementRef="BusinessOwnerRepresentative">
        <bpmn:documentation>Sends the Statement of Interest and the Letter of Application; may meet WHO in person (Framework IX). ActorDefinition http://smart.who.int/trust/ActorDefinition/BusinessOwnerRepresentative.</bpmn:documentation>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Draft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.Recv</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>TP.End</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="TP.Start" name="Need for a new Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3: one or more Eligible GDHCN Participants may propose one.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_104</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="TP.Draft" name="Describe the proposed Trust Domain">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3: use cases, technical specifications, and policy and regulatory standards.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_104</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_105</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="TP.Send" name="Propose it to the Secretariat">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework V.3.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_105</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_106</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="TP.Recv" name="Receive the published Annex">
      <bpmn:documentation>Framework XI.2.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_106</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_107</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="TP.End" name="Trust Domain in effect">
      <bpmn:documentation></bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_107</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_104" sourceRef="TP.Start" targetRef="TP.Draft" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_105" sourceRef="TP.Draft" targetRef="TP.Send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_106" sourceRef="TP.Send" targetRef="TP.Recv" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_107" sourceRef="TP.Recv" targetRef="TP.End" />
  </bpmn:process>

Instance: TrustNetworkAnchor
InstanceOf: $SGActor
Usage: #definition
* name = "Trust Network Anchor"
* title = "Trust Network Anchor"

* experimental = true

* type = $actorType#system

Instance: TrustNetworkParticipant
InstanceOf: $SGActor
Usage: #definition
* name = "Trust Network Participant"
* title = "Trust Network Participant"
* description = "Trust Network Participant which publishes and or receives PKI-material within a Trust Network"
* status = $pubStatus#active
* experimental = true
* publisher = "WHO"
* type = $actorType#system



Instance: Holder
InstanceOf: $SGActor
Usage: #definition
* name = "Holder"
* title = "Holder"
* description = "A Holder is an individual that has Verifiable Digtial Health Certificate in their possesion, received from an Issuer.  The Holder may choose to share the Verifiable Digital Health Certificate with a Receiver."
* status = $pubStatus#active
* experimental = true
* publisher = "WHO"
* type = $actorType#person

Instance: Issuer
InstanceOf: $SGActor
Usage: #definition
* name = "Issuer"
* title = "Issuer"
* description = "An Issuer a system authorized by a Trust Network Participant to generate Verifiable Digital Health Certificates which are provided to a Holder.   An Issuer is responsible for generating the content that is digitally signed within the Verifiable Digital Health Certificate.   In order to sign this content, an Issuer should either itself be a Document Signer or utilize a Document Signer service, as authorized by the jurisdicitonal policy."
* status = $pubStatus#active
* experimental = true
* publisher = "WHO"
* type = $actorType#system
* derivedFrom = Canonical(TrustNetworkParticipant)

Instance: Receiver
InstanceOf: $SGActor
Usage: #definition
* name = "Receiver"
* title = "Receiver"
* description = "A Reciever is a system authorized by a Trust Network Participant to receive from a Holder a Veritifable, verify and utilize the content within."
* status = $pubStatus#active
* experimental = true
* publisher = "WHO"
* type = $actorType#system
* derivedFrom = Canonical(TrustNetworkParticipant)
